steps.title: Scripts and scenes, ready made
steps.body: The starter pack has ten script templates (a locked door, a shop, a boss fight, waves of enemies…) and three cutscene templates. You fill in a short form; it becomes ordinary logic or a scene you can change. They are at the end of Starter pack.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: Three to beat
steps.body: “Clear the room, find the treasure” needs enemies on the map. Place three Pebblespouts (Starter pack › Enemies › Place, three times).

steps.title: Make the script
steps.body: Under Scripts and cutscenes, press Use… on “Clear the room, find the treasure”. Set How many to 3 and At to Arrival (where the chest appears), then Make it. It opens in Logic: an On defeated that counts, and at 3 spawns a Boss chest and plays the secret-found sound.
steps.task: Make “Clear the room, find the treasure”.

check.args: Clear the room, find the treasure

steps.title: Clear the room
steps.body: Press Play and beat the three Pebblespouts (F swings). When the third falls: “A treasure chest appeared!”.
steps.task: Press Play and beat all three.

steps.title: A boss entrance
steps.body: Stop the game. Place Gloomweaver (Starter pack › Enemies), then Use… on “Boss entrance”: the camera turns to the boss, it roars, its name comes up and the boss music starts. Make it opens the scene in Cinematics; ▶ there plays it.

steps.title: Keep it for every project
steps.body: My library (next to Starter pack) keeps your own things for every project in this browser. Press + Add from this game…, tick the script “Clear the room, find the treasure” and Save. In another project, Use in this game brings it in.
steps.task: Save the script to My library.

check.args: Clear the room, find the treasure

args.name: Clear the room, find the treasure

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You made a script and a scene from templates, played the script, and kept it in My library. The other templates (a shop, a boss fight, waves, a race against the clock, an escort…) work the same way. Help › Script and cutscene templates and My library say more.
